```
def can_make_all_zeroes(n, arr):
    # If even, always possible
    if n % 2 == 0:
        return "YES"
    
    # Find max in O(n) time complexity
    max_val = arr[0]
    max_pos = 0
    for i, val in enumerate(arr):
        if val > max_val:
            max_val = val
            max_pos = i
    
    # Return if max_pos doesn't exist, always possible
    if max_pos == n - 1:
        return "YES"
    
    # Else check if sub-arrays can be all zeros
    for i in range(max_pos):
        if arr[i] > 0:
            return "NO"
    
    for i in range(max_pos + 1, n):
        if arr[i] > 0:
            return "NO"
    
    return "YES"
```
